component.name: Playlist Downloader
component.summary: Download playlists from any site offline

description.p: Playlist Downloader saves whole playlists offline as video or audio: search YouTube, or paste a playlist link from SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Vimeo and hundreds of other sites, pick the items and download them. A playlist downloader for the Linux desktop.

ul.li: Search YouTube playlists by keyword, with suggestions as you type
Paste a playlist link from any site the download engine reads, or a link to a single video or track
Browse the playlist: every item with its thumbnail and length; pick the ones you want or a range
Download as MP4, MKV or WebM up to 4K, or audio only as MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV, with subtitles, thumbnails and metadata embedded
A queue with pause, resume and retry, files in a folder per playlist, numbered in playlist order, and a notification when the download finishes
A playlist file (m3u8) next to the files, so your music player plays the whole playlist in order
A built-in browser for any site with a Download button on every page; sign in once and members-only and age-restricted items download too
The download engine sets itself up on first use and keeps itself updated
